summary: Iteration 7 retest of all iteration_6 findings — ALL FIXES VERIFIED. Backend: added /app/backend/tests/test_iter7_fixes.py (9 tests, all pass) covering (a) PUT /api/admin/settings plan_price_inr=0 and -5 -> 422 (was 500), (b) partial save {plan_price_inr:777} preserves razorpay_key_id 'rzp_test_PRESERVE' + support_email and propagates to /api/public/config, restore to 999 + empty keys verified, (c) require_write: staff Type=Manager + Permission=View -> POST /api/members 403 'Your role has view-only access' while GET /api/members still 200; Manager + Permission=manage can create members, (d) DELETE /api/staff/{id} removes the staff row, second delete -> 404, and the linked login user is gone (login now 401), (e) discount >= plan+admission with amount_paid=0 -> payable 0, due 0, payment_status 'Paid' (verified on create AND on GET), (f) demo org batches = exactly Morning (6-8 AM)/Afternoon (12-2 PM)/Evening (5-8 PM). Full regression: cleanup -> pytest tests/ -q -p no:randomly -n 0 -> 163 passed / 0 failed (154 previous + 9 new) -> cleanup. Auth playbook re-verified: bcrypt hashes start with $2b$ (owner + super admin), login sets HttpOnly/Secure/SameSite=None cookies, app-level CORS uses explicit FRONTEND_URL origin with allow_credentials, forgot-password returns an identical generic 200 for registered and unregistered emails, reset tokens stored only as sha256 token_hash (no raw token), lockout + reset flows covered by backend_test.py (passing). Frontend (Playwright, public URL): view-only staff (TEST_QA ViewOnly, permission=view) -> /app/finance, /app/reports, /app/export-center all render finance-access-denied 'No finance access' with NO CRA red overlay and ZERO console errors; no add-member-button, no dashboard quick actions, no record-payment-button, no add-enquiry-button; member drawer action sheet shows exactly Show More Info / Attendance History / Send Payment Reminder / Transaction History (freeze/edit/delete/renew/record-payment all absent). Demo owner: Add Member 3-step stepper OK, batch dropdown shows exactly the 3 canonical batches + '+ New batch', step-3 membership preview now formatted 'Membership: 03 Sept 2026 -> 03 Oct 2026 (1 months)', payment summary maths correct; editing the member created without email/dob produced ZERO console errors (no 'value prop on input should not be null'); Plans Category column shows 'Membership' labels and PT/Service/Product tabs are legible; super admin console (KPIs, gyms table, Platform Settings form, audit tab) loads clean. All test data purged: demo gym back to 26 members / 3 staff / 3 batches, platform settings restored (price 999, empty razorpay keys, whatsapp_number and support_email cleared).
